remarks_1999: Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert to Rome, Nov. 1956. Sales slip states 'Waterfall I." Titled *Waterfall II* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, Whitney Archive, in 1969.
titles.title: Waterfall II

description: A white waterfall cuts through the center of a large, brown cliff face. Clouds of blue and white mist emanate from the waterfall as it hits a set of rocks below. A tiny patch of gray sky is visible just above the cliffs at the center of the image.
title: Waterfall II
